newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fischler to present tobacco report to farm ministers.
newsitem.headline: Fischler to present tobacco report to farm ministers.

text.p: Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler will on Monday present a tobacco report to farm ministers urging that EU subsidies be aimed at improving quality and encouraging farmers to stop production, EU diplomats said.
The report also called for stricter controls and a simplification of the subsidy system.
The report (COM 96/554) was adopted by the Commission on December 18 despite strong criticism that the subsidies hampered efforts to curb smoking related deaths.

But Fischler successfully argued that abolition of the tobacco aid system would put some 200,000 people out of work -- mainly in Greece and southern Italy -- with little prospect of finding alternative employment.
He also said it would have little effect on consumption of tobacco as the EU already imports 77 percent of its needs.
